svg.title: What a person can read after one step
svg.desc: Two rows for the step: place a cell in voltage tester 1. Row 1, the course stack, has four records joined by arrows: the agent's tool call with its name and arguments (blue); the schema check, valid or the rule it broke (blue); the behavior tree's status of each node (green); the skill result, success or a failure reason (orange). Row 2, a VLA: camera images and the instruction go into one VLA model, drawn with a dashed border and marked as learned features, not readable; it outputs robot actions, and the last box is the outcome: placed, dropped, or a collision penalty.
